Biography
Robert Lightfoot earned his Ph.D. in Multidisciplinary Engineering and B.S. in Computer Science from Texas A&M University, and an M.S. in Computer Science from Southern Methodist University.
His career includes work at Ericsson and DSC (Motorola) and independent development of smart sorting systems.
His teaching and research focus on software engineering and computer science education.
